message.content: I’ve had the yellowing of my skin and eyes, the dark stools, feeling very tired and light‑headed for about four days, and it’s been getting worse each day. I haven’t had any belly pain, fever, itching, weight loss or any change in the color of my urine that I’ve noticed. I don’t have a known liver disease or gallstones, and I haven’t been drinking heavily. The only new medication I’ve had is a single pembrolizumab infusion about two weeks ago; I don’t remember any other new drugs.
